name: Mirrors
long_description: Mirrors gives developers the infrastructure to control what production AI agents are told, and when. Today that lives in long prompts and skills the agent may never open, so agents keep breaking rules they've already been given. With Mirrors, a developer writes a rule once and defines where it applies, and Mirrors delivers it at the exactly where the agent needs to see it and measures whether it helped. It works with any agent framework and any model.
one_liner: The guidance system for production AI agents
